scripts.test: npm run format:check && npm run build && npm run lint:html && playwright test
scripts.test:docker: docker build -t eliocapella-tests . && docker run --rm eliocapella-tests
scripts.test:visual: npm run build && playwright test tests/visual.spec.js
scripts.test:visual:update: npm run build && playwright test tests/visual.spec.js --update-snapshots
scripts.test:visual:update:docker: docker build -t eliocapella-tests . && docker run --rm --volume "$PWD/tests/visual.spec.js-snapshots:/site/tests/visual.spec.js-snapshots" eliocapella-tests npm run test:visual:update
